declaration.statement: Candidate source packet for independent review of the official Karmada policy CRD change that removes deprecated application failover purgeMode values Immediately and Graciously between 1.18.3 and 1.19.0.

limitations: Tag bindings, source bytes, full-file digests, line spans, and attribution require independent retrieval and review.
The packet does not establish compatibility, authorize or add a rule, prove runtime or API-server behavior, or change coverage counts.
The existing Karmada rule registry evidence is outside this candidate packet and is not revalidated or modified here.
No upstream source body or archive is redistributed; the packet keeps only bounded excerpts and immutable references.
